en: Simple machines do not reduce the total work done; they reduce the effort force needed by increasing the distance over which the force is applied.
Friction does not always slow things down; it actually pushes you forward when you walk by gripping the ground against the soles of your shoes.
Without air resistance, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather dropped from the same height will hit the ground at exactly the same time.
Magnets do not attract all metals; they only attract specific metals such as iron, nickel, and cobalt, but not aluminum, copper, or gold.
Electric current is not used up as it flows through a circuit; the same amount of current flows through every part of a simple series circuit.
Light does not need any material medium to travel through; it can travel through the empty vacuum of space, which is how sunlight reaches Earth.
Sound cannot travel through a vacuum; it needs a physical medium such as air, water, or a solid object to carry its vibrations.
Cold does not flow into warm objects; instead, heat always flows from warmer objects to cooler objects until both reach the same temperature.
Energy is never created or destroyed; it only changes forms, such as chemical energy in rice changing to kinetic energy when you run.
A single fixed pulley does not reduce the force needed to lift a load; it only changes the direction of the force you apply.
The magnetic pull of a bar magnet is not strongest at its center; it is strongest at its two ends, called the north and south poles.
A light switch does not create electricity when you turn it on; it merely completes the circuit to allow electric current to flow through the wires.
